sources.title: GitHub - gradients-ai/G.O.D: Gradients on demand · GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the Gradients on Demand subnet. G.O.D is the subnet runtime behind Gradients.io training jobs and tournaments. Validators create tasks, coordinate miner and trainer infrastructure, evaluate results, and set weights. Miners expose training repositories for tournament tasks; trainers run those repositories on validator-controlled GPU infrastructure.
